title: Hold a licence to handle explosives
what: Manufacture, store or sell explosives (and store shopgoods fireworks) only under a licence; importing or exporting prescribed explosives needs the Competent Authority's approval (reg 5C).

sources.title: Dangerous Goods Regulations 1985 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not manufacture explosives except under and in accordance with the terms and conditions of a licence

sources.title: Dangerous Goods Regulations 1985 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not store explosives on premises except under and in accordance with the terms and conditions of a licence

sources.title: Dangerous Goods Regulations 1985 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not sell explosives (other than safety cartridges, distress signals or propellant for firearms) except under and in accordance with the terms and conditions of a licence

administration.who: Competent Authority under the dangerous goods law (NT)
